newsitem.title: FRANCE: Cheuvreux raises rating on Skis Rossignol.
newsitem.headline: Cheuvreux raises rating on Skis Rossignol.

text.p: French brokerage Cheuvreux de Virieu raised its rating on the stock of sports equipment firm Skis Rossignol to '2', or buy, from '3', or neutral, after Skis Rossignol reported an 11.4 percent rise in nine-month sales.
Cheuvreux also raised its earnings per share (EPS) estimates for the group to 9.9 francs for 1996/97 from 9.6 francs previously, and to 11.6 francs for 1997/98 from 11.3 francs.
Shares in Skis Rossignol were up 7.64 percent at 163.50 francs at 1520 GMT, within striking distance of their 12-month high of 175.88 francs set in July 1996.
